method: Production sync_all, unchanged durable frames, single journal owner. Full readback and reopen after timing. External time includes verification/reopen/cleanup. Groupwidth4 is a different aggregation boundary than width1, not an equal-latency comparison. No SQL/HTTP/MQTT.
sync_count_note: Successful data sync_all calls within append group paths, including rotations. Excludes initialization, directory sync, state operations, checkpoint and reopen. Logical group calls can touch several segments and require multiple data syncs.

calls.percentile_method: nearest-rank, ceil(p*N/100), measured per API call; not per-record percentiles

writing.latency_definition: per complete group API call until durable return; NOT per-request enqueue latency; preparation outside API timer but inside wall throughput
